summary_en: 82,000 shares (1.75% of ex-treasury S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥184/share, total ¥15.09M. Settlement 2024-08-20 AM. Single-day open-market block transaction.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Purchase of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 19 August 2024, Kawase Computer Supplies' board authorized the acquisition of 82,000 treasury shares (1.75% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The purchase will occur on 20 August 2024 at the closing price of ¥184 per share, for a total outlay of ¥15,088,000. The buy order is subject to matching against sell orders placed on that trading day only; partial or full non-execution is possible depending on market conditions. Results will be disclosed after the 08:45 AM trading window closes. The company cites responsive capital management in a changing operating environment as the rationale for the buyback.
